Name: ChestItemFinder
Author: cynthiazhao0411
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
ChestItemFinder helps you find which chest holds the item you're looking for. Press a single key to open a search box, and every chest containing that item pulses yellow in the world. An on-screen message tells you how many chests were found and in which locations. Built for late-game farms where you have too many chests to remember what's in each one.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the zip and extract the ChestItemFinder folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Load a save and press **H** (default key) to open the search box. Type the item name and press Enter.
*(You can change the search key in `config.json` or in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.)*


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Searches every chest in every location, including building interiors (like sheds) and Ginger Island[/*]
[*]Press H to open a clean in-game search box instead of typing console commands[/*]
[*]Matches both localized display names and internal English names, so it works in any game language[/*]
[*]Smart matching: Case-insensitive partial matching (e.g. "gem" or "fish" finds all items in that category). If an exact match exists, it prioritizes it (e.g. "Starfruit" won't match "Starfruit Wine", but you can search "Starfruit Wine" directly)[/*]
[*]Matching chests pulse yellow in the world[/*]
[*]Summary message shows how many chests were found and where they are located[/*]
[*]Highlights automatically clear after you open any target chest[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, to change the default H keybind in-game)
